title: Federal target detection learning method based on characterization enhancement and weighted aggregation in cloud edge environment

pse.problem: Heterogeneous sample distribution between different data sets in federated learning target detection leads to suboptimal global model performance.
pse.solution_function: Federated learning for target detection involves local edge server training, weighted aggregation, and central cloud server updates. The function aims to alleviate the problem of heterogeneous sample distribution by adjusting the loss function and weighting during training.
pse.solution_structure: The system consists of distributed edge servers, central cloud servers, and client devices. Edge servers perform local training and aggregation; central cloud servers update global models based on aggregated data.
pse.solution_implementation: Liu (International Conference on Vision, Image and Signal Processing, 2019) calculates the divergence between client model weight distribution on the server side to generate a mask for the model weight. Sarkar (International Joint Conference on Artificial Intelligence, 2020) introduces the Fed-Focal loss function that weights the loss of well-classified samples during training.
pse.effect: The solution can improve the performance of federated target detection learning by addressing the issue of heterogeneous sample distribution and resulting suboptimal global model performance.
